nodes.title: Non-negative points of a weighted rank-3 matroid are connected by non-negative lines

nodes.title: Connectivity question for weighted rank-3 matroids

nodes.summary: A set $L$ of points is a line of a matroid $M$ on elements of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ when $L$ is a flat of $M$ of rank $2$.
nodes.title: Line of a matroid

nodes.summary: A matroid $M$ on elements of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is simple when the set $\{e, f\}$ is independent in $M$ for all $e, f \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}$, so that every set of at most two of these elements is independent (no loops, no parallel pairs).
nodes.title: Simple matroid

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a matroid on elements of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ and let $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1}$ be real weights, the weight of a set of points being the sum of the weights of its points. The graph of non-negative lines has as vertices the points $i$ with $a_i \ge 0$, and two distinct vertices are adjacent when some line of $M$ (a flat of rank $2$) contains both and has non-negative weight.
nodes.title: Graph of non-negative lines

nodes.summary: Given real weights $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1}$ on the points $0, \dots, n-1$, the weight of a set $S$ of points is $\sum_{i \in S} a_i$.
nodes.title: Weight of a set of points

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
